name: Adding contacts through the system editor
plain: An app creates or edits a contact by opening the system editor, not by writing silently.
meaning: Prevents apps from planting or altering contacts in the background; the person sees and approves each change.

android.permission: MANAGE_CONTACTS (special app access, arrives Android 17 QPR2) for programmatic writes; WRITE_CONTACTS ends for apps targeting the 2027 release
android.prompt_ui: ACTION_INSERT, ACTION_EDIT, ACTION_INSERT_OR_EDIT need no permission
android.note: Announced 21 Oct 2026; People Directory also arrives in QPR2

ios.permission: NSContactsUsageDescription for CNSaveRequest; none for CNContactViewController UI
ios.prompt_ui: Full or limited access prompt for saves; editor UI needs none
ios.note: Writing needs full access; limited access allows apps to write only contacts they created

limits.headline: Can open the system contact screen so you add or edit a contact yourself
limits.user_action: You tap Add to contacts and press Save in the system screen
can: Open the system editor with details filled in
Insert or edit a contact with no permission (Android)
Let you review each change before it is saved
cannot: Change contacts in the background without the editor
Save the contact itself; you press Save
Make direct changes on Android without special access that arrives with Android 17 QPR2
Change contacts it did not create when you chose limited access (iPhone)
limits.differs: Android 17 QPR2 adds a special access setting for direct changes; iPhone direct saves need a prompt and limited access allows only contacts the app created.

story.what_it_is: The app opens the phone's own contact screen to add someone, so nothing is saved without you seeing it.
story.for_you: A normal Add Contact screen opens with the name and number filled in. You review and tap Save. The app never gets to read your address book.
story.for_makers: The app can offer save contact without a permission prompt or a review hit. The system enforces the safe route. The cost is one extra tap for the person.

use_cases.example: A business card scanner turns a card into a contact with one tap to save.
A shop app lets you save a store's phone number.
A sales app saves a lead as a contact you can call back.
A hotel app saves the front desk number.
A clinic app saves its phone number into your contacts.
A delivery app saves your driver's contact.
A conference app saves a speaker's details.

risks: Wrong details could be saved if not read
story.android_note: Google announced an in system contact editing option on 21 Oct 2026, and a People Directory arrives in QPR2.
story.ios_note: On iOS, full contacts access is needed to write directly. Limited access lets an app write only contacts it created.

technical_bounds: Dated from the Android blog of 21 Oct 2026; final API names may change before release

abuse: Silent contact spam, spoofed caller names

history.change: Direct WRITE_CONTACTS writes end for new targets; intents and MANAGE_CONTACTS replace them
Limited access allows writes for contacts the app created
